Discover Our Products and Services

Below we present SignalHire's products and services.

Use this overview to choose the tools that fit your sales, recruiting, and marketing workflows.

Contact Finder

Find verified personal and business emails plus direct dials in real time. One credit returns every available contact for a profile and is only charged on success.

  • 95%+ email accuracy with live verification.
  • Email + phone from social media and across the web via UI or extension.
  • Bulk enrich up to 1,000 people per run.
Explore more

Browser Extension

Reveal contacts on social media platforms and most websites in one click. Works on Chrome and Firefox with free monthly credits.

  • Finds emails and phone numbers on Facebook, GitHub, Twitter, and more.
  • +10 free credits each month when installed.
  • One-click export to ATS and CRMs
Explore more

Email Sequences

Automate multi-step cold email outreach from your own mailbox with tracking and rules. Launch, pause on reply, and measure results. Built for cold outreach to net-new prospects. Steps, delays, send windows, and analytics for opens and replies. Send via Outlook/Office 365 or company domain. Add prospects in bulk from Lead Lists or Projects.

Explore more

API

Add contact discovery and enrichment to your product with simple REST endpoints. Secure, scalable, and credit-aware.

  • Person API returns full profiles and verified contacts by social media profile URL, email, or phone.
  • Search API finds people or companies with filters; returns overviews for list building.
  • API-key auth, credits in headers, documented rate limits.
Explore more

Database

Search 850M+ profiles and 30M+ companies with ongoing updates. Full contacts in real time when you view a profile.

  • Emails for up to 90% and phones for up to 80% of people.
  • Filters by name, title, company, location; save to Lead Lists or Projects; export to CSV/ATS/CRM.
  • Enrich or export up to 1000 profiles or companies at a time.
Explore more

CRM & ATS Sync

Push verified contacts directly into your pipeline the moment you find them. No exports, no manual entry, no switching tools.

  • Export contacts from any search or profile.
  • Syncs to your existing records without creating duplicates.
  • CSV fallback for any tool not covered natively.
  • API for teams with custom workflows.
Explore more

SignalHire possibilities

Verified contacts only

All emails are found in a real-time mode. Before displaying any contact details on the screen they are being verified via 3rd-party verification tools. We've done the job for you!

Find email addresses in bulk

Unlike other tools, SignalHire allows its users seek data in bulk for up to 1000 people at a time!

Find emails by name, position or location

SignalHire is equipped with powerful search filters that allow you to find addresses by a person's name, title or location!

Use our Free Extension on ANY website on the WEB

Get anyone's verified data by name: emails, phone numbers, social media profiles on Facebook, X, GitHub, MeetUp, Dribble, Gmail, Xing, LinkedIn®, Quora etc. Any website on the WEB. Assign individuals to your jobs in one click.
